Name: Miss Coriel's NPC Tool Kit (Mod ToolKit)
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
This mod, while it's made to work on the currently in development NPC Creator 4 (NPC Creator NT), is a good way to acquire some information for those who like to do things themselves.

[b]What does it do?[/b]
[list]
[*]Acquires giftable item ids (even ones added by mods!! No more looking for their IDs)
[*]Generates a map list (including maps added by mods)
[*]Acquires all NPC names (including modded NPCs)
[*]Separates romancable NPCs and married ones
[*]Acquires all Music, SFX and Ambient IDs!
[*]Pressing CTRL + L saves the Farmer's Position in the format of a schedule location (Map X Y Facing)
[/list]
The data saves in the ExtractedData folder added to you SDV folder.  Inside will be the files you can read with any text editor.  Within is also the Coordinates folder.  That carries the file that carries all of your saved locations.  
This mod is aware of other mods and their data will show on the relevant file.  It also checks to see if an NPC can be in a certain location.. it will not save coordinates that an NPC cannot go.
[b]1.1.0 Update:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Item Acquisition: [/b]Using the create itemlist command will now generate useable itemlists and sorts all items into their own jsons by their identifier.
[/list][b]1.0.1 Update:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Fixed bug: [/b]Fixed a bug where acquisition of coordinates did not give proper facing direction.
[/list]
